failure_mode: A briefing offered a guideline passage may restate it in one sentence cited to the passage's 12-character id; its numbers must match the quote. A sentence that quotes a threshold the passage does not state is stripped, and a sentence about the patient still cites fact ids. A failure means guideline text reaches the briefing unverified, or verified guideline sentences are dropped.

chunks.quote: In adults 40 to 75 years of age with LDL-C 70 to 189 mg/dL and a 10-year ASCVD risk of 7.5 percent or higher, moderate-intensity statin therapy is recommended.

sentences.text: The LDL cholesterol was 165 mg/dL on 2026-09-10, above the standard range.
The AHA/ACC guideline recommends moderate-intensity statin therapy for adults 40 to 75 with LDL-C 70 to 189 mg/dL and a 10-year ASCVD risk of 7.5 percent or higher.
The guideline sets an LDL goal below 55 mg/dL for this patient.
